leads.finding: Predicts accent assignments and grammatical groupings. It does not supply sung pitches. No engine code/data reused; no general source-code license established. Source audit gives primary Wickes/Price/Breuer leads for independent research.

Fundamental-frequency estimation from periodicity is measurement, not a reviewed musical score. Prototype independently implements fixed-window squared differences, cumulative normalization, thresholded local minima and parabolic interpolation. No global-minimum fallback or paper step6; uncertain frames remain unassigned. Threshold score is not a probability of musical correctness. No published code copied.

plan: Evaluate source-recording pitch measurements across available Torah timings, preserving source identity and explicit gaps. Keep word timing separate from absent syllable/phoneme timing, exact Hebrew, source text styles and traditional grammar claims. All final full-reconstruction requirements remain active.
